conventional_tts_replacement.normalization_policy: no loudness normalization; preserve model waveform scale and clip only to [-1,1] at the adapter boundary
conventional_tts_replacement.quality_gate_policy: finite waveform; mono; exact target-span insertion; output 16000 Hz; no corruption; contract structural checks
conventional_tts_replacement.reference_rule: No external waveform reference; synthesize the frozen case target transcript with the pinned single-speaker LJS checkpoint.
conventional_tts_replacement.seed_policy: SHA256(protocol_id||distribution_id||case_id||mechanism_family||W7_MECHANISM_SEED_V1)[:64bits], converted to unsigned 64-bit and applied to Python/NumPy/PyTorch before inference
conventional_tts_replacement.target_span_rule: Replace exactly the frozen case target span [gt.start_sec, gt.end_sec); generated audio is linearly resampled to the target duration before deterministic boundary insertion.

cross_speaker_boundary_control.normalization_policy: no loudness normalization; finite float32 samples are clipped to [-1,1]

parameters.boundary_fallback: terminal failure if no distinct-speaker reference exists

cross_speaker_boundary_control.quality_gate_policy: finite waveform; mono; valid duration; sample rate 16000; clip only to [-1,1]; structural contract checks
cross_speaker_boundary_control.reference_rule: reference is the next lexicographically ordered case in the same distribution with a different source_id; take its first available mono waveform window and resample it to target duration
cross_speaker_boundary_control.seed_policy: No stochastic operation; existing case seed is not consumed
cross_speaker_boundary_control.target_span_rule: target span is the frozen GT interval [start_sample, end_sample) at 16000 Hz; no per-case manual selection

neural_speech_editing_infilling.codec_path: Encodec 4-codebook 2048-entry model at 16000 Hz from official VoiceCraft source
neural_speech_editing_infilling.normalization_policy: no loudness normalization; preserve official decoder scale and clip only at contract boundary
neural_speech_editing_infilling.quality_gate_policy: finite waveform; mono; output 16000 Hz; valid alignment; no corruption; structural contract checks
neural_speech_editing_infilling.reference_rule: Use the same-case source waveform and frozen source transcript; forced alignment identifies the deterministic boundary around the frozen target interval.
neural_speech_editing_infilling.seed_policy: SHA256(protocol_id||distribution_id||case_id||mechanism_family||W7_MECHANISM_SEED_V1)[:64bits], converted to unsigned 64-bit and applied to Python/NumPy/PyTorch/CUDA deterministic settings
neural_speech_editing_infilling.target_span_rule: MFA english_us_arpa alignment at beam=50 and retry_beam=200; choose the first word boundary at or after frozen gt.start_sec and the first boundary at or after frozen gt.end_sec; terminal failure if either boundary is absent.

same_speaker_splice_crossfade_control.normalization_policy: no loudness normalization; finite float32 samples are clipped to [-1,1]

parameters.boundary_fallback: terminal failure if no complete same-case window exists

same_speaker_splice_crossfade_control.quality_gate_policy: finite waveform; mono; valid duration; sample rate 16000; clip only to [-1,1]; structural contract checks
same_speaker_splice_crossfade_control.reference_rule: reference is the nearest complete non-target context window from the same case, preferring the immediately preceding window and then the immediately following window
same_speaker_splice_crossfade_control.seed_policy: No stochastic operation; existing case seed is not consumed
same_speaker_splice_crossfade_control.target_span_rule: target span is the frozen GT interval [start_sample, end_sample) at 16000 Hz; no per-case manual selection

voice_conditioned_tts_vc_replacement.implementation: Edresson/YourTTS with official Coqui TTS released model
voice_conditioned_tts_vc_replacement.normalization_policy: no loudness normalization; preserve official model waveform scale and clip only at adapter boundary
voice_conditioned_tts_vc_replacement.quality_gate_policy: finite waveform; mono; valid target duration; output 16000 Hz; no corruption; structural contract checks
voice_conditioned_tts_vc_replacement.reference_rule: Use the next lexicographically ordered case in the same distribution with a different source_id as the target-speaker reference; use the current case waveform as content/reference_wav.
voice_conditioned_tts_vc_replacement.seed_policy: SHA256(protocol_id||distribution_id||case_id||mechanism_family||W7_MECHANISM_SEED_V1)[:64bits], converted to unsigned 64-bit and applied to Python/NumPy/PyTorch before CLI invocation
voice_conditioned_tts_vc_replacement.target_span_rule: Generate the frozen case target transcript with the target speaker reference, resample generated audio to the frozen target duration, then replace exactly [gt.start_sec, gt.end_sec) at 16000 Hz.
voice_conditioned_tts_vc_replacement.version: YourTTS commit 23904e6b7158d42cacf2a94dba0791ef69f1e2a9; Coqui TTS tag v0.7.0 commit c7cca4135db0c108a30ba8fd6a437fb63a5ecc12
